notes.content: It is very important for students who intend to major in Physics to complete most of the core preparatory courses listed below during their first two college years. By completing the 4 semesters of Mathematics, 3 semesters of Physics, and 2 semesters of Chemistry, students will be prepared to take upper-division Physics courses necessary for the major after transfer. The Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) in Physics is compatible with the B.A. in Physics at Sacramento State. Students pursuing the Associate Degree for Transfer must complete all lower-division major coursework with a "C" or better. For additional information, please visit: Department of Physics .
